claims: Seychelles is an archipelago nation with 115 islands.
Seychelles is located in the Indian Ocean off East Africa.
Aldabra is a nature reserve in Seychelles.
The capital of Seychelles is Victoria.
Victoria is located on Mahé island.
Seychelles is located in the Western Indian Ocean near the equator.
Seychelles has a population of around 100,000.
Seychelles is considered one of the wealthiest countries in Africa by GDP per capita.
Seychelles is visa-exempt for most tourists.
A travel authorization is required before arrival in Seychelles.
A health check is required before arrival in Seychelles.
The official languages of Seychelles are Seychellois Creole, English, and French.
The currency of Seychelles is the Seychellois Rupee (SCR).
